title: Wayfare Pass Ride Credit — Eligible Fare Calculation Sheet
content:
# Eligible fare for Pass ride credit — calculation sheet (Wayfare Pass)

**Definition.** For Pass ride credit posted on a trip of a Wayfare Pass (rider membership) member, the eligible-fare basis depends on how the fare was set: where the rider changed the route and the fare charge was recalculated to more than the upfront fare less the member discount recorded on it, the eligible fare is the upfront fare less the ride option's booking fee and less that member discount; where a fare adjustment has been booked against the fare charge, the eligible fare is the fare charge net of those adjustments less the booking fee; otherwise it is the fare charge less the booking fee; in every case never below 0.00.

The first case is tested first; the second applies only where the first does not.

## Records read, all in Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)

| Item | Record |
|---|---|
| Route changed | The trip record shows the rider added a stop or changed the destination |
| Recalculated | The fare charge's fare basis is recalculated (rather than upfront or minimum fare) |
| Upfront fare | The fare quoted on the trip before Pass discount and credits, booking fee included |
| Member discount | The member discount recorded on the fare charge |
| Fare adjustments | Fare adjustments that name the fare charge as the charge they adjust |
| Booking fee | The booking fee of the trip's ride option |

## Decision table

| Route changed and recalculated above upfront fare less member discount | Fare adjustment booked against the fare charge | Eligible fare |
|---|---|---|
| yes | either | upfront fare less booking fee less member discount |
| no | yes | fare charge net of adjustments less booking fee |
| no | no | fare charge less booking fee |

## Worked cases (hypothetical inputs, booking fee taken as 2.70)

1. Route changed; upfront fare 25.00; no member discount; fare recalculated to 31.00, which is more than 25.00. Eligible fare: 25.00 less 2.70, that is 22.30.
2. Route changed; upfront fare 25.00; fare recalculated to 24.00, not more than 25.00; no adjustment. The first case does not apply: eligible fare 24.00 less 2.70, that is 21.30.
3. No route change; fare charge 30.00 with a fare adjustment of 6.00 booked against it. Eligible fare: 24.00 less 2.70, that is 21.30.
4. No route change, no adjustment, fare charge 30.00: 27.30.
5. Fare charge 2.00 with a booking fee of 2.70: never below 0.00, so 0.00.
